public_sources: Harness Evolver source-bound evidence inherited only from own sequence-65 checkpoint

actions: Compared public stagnation responses: stop, widen/redirect, and improvement-policy/architecture reopen.
Audited MetaSkill-Evolve meta-on versus frozen slow-loop evidence and its cadence/computation confound.
Audited HSI as a five-outer-iteration meta-policy rewrite system.
Audited Adaptive Auto-Harness current generic convergence path and exact egl_window/egl_threshold implementation boundary.
Persisted a source-bound strategy-reopening comparison matrix.
Checkpointed sequence 66 and advanced role-local LATEST with CAS.

result.main_new_finding: Public systems now source-bind three distinct stagnation responses—stop, widen/redirect, and meta-policy/architecture reopen—but no public real-LLM system found in this run cleanly compares them in one >10-proposal system under matched proposal/evaluation budgets while also providing anytime-valid candidate promotion, durable cross-proposal statistical spending, complete chronology, and an untouched outer test.
result.important_positive_evidence: MetaSkill-Evolve provides held-out meta-on versus frozen-slow-loop gains, supporting improvement-policy adaptation as a useful mutable layer, but its slow updates are scheduled and its H sweep changes fast-loop iteration/evaluation budget.
result.important_implementation_boundary: Adaptive Auto-Harness current generic EvolutionLoop stops on convergence; in the audited path egl_window is passed into convergence checking while egl_threshold is not, leaving epsilon at the function default 0.01 on that exact path.

termination.cause: current invocation checkpoint boundary after completing source-bound comparison and durable persistence

exact_next_action: Search for a same-system Stop-vs-Widen-vs-Reopen experiment under equal proposal/evaluation budgets, preferably >10 proposals and with promotion evidence, reopening evidence, and untouched outer evaluation as separate channels. Audit any candidate for candidate-local anytime-valid acceptance and restart-durable cross-proposal statistical spending. If no such experiment is public, extend the source-bound strategy-reopening matrix only with an implementation that materially closes a missing column rather than repeating generic meta-learning evidence.
